LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberNoLimbs: {0} has no limbs to tear off.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberConfirmKill: The strike will tear off {PAWN_nameDef}'s head, which will kill {PAWN_objective}.\n\nAre you sure?
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberConfirmDrainKill: Draining hemogen from {PAWN_nameDef} after the strike will kill {PAWN_objective}.\n\nAre you sure?
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberReload: Each strike will burn out one of the servos in the shoulders, which can be replaced by reloading with {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_SettingsUnavailable: The ability and helmet settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the hemophage warcasket, so they will keep their built-in values.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushStartCostDesc: The amount of hemogen the pilot spends at once each time a rush starts. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushDrainDesc: The amount of hemogen the pilot spends each second while the rush is running. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushReserveDesc: The hemogen level at which the rush will stop on its own. At zero, it will run until the pilot has no hemogen left and develops a hemogen craving. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushMoveSpeedDesc: The pilot's move speed during a hemogen rush, compared to normal. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushMeleeDamageDesc: How much damage the pilot's melee attacks will do during a hemogen rush, compared to normal. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushGlowPulseDesc: When enabled, the warcasket's glow will pulse like a heartbeat during a hemogen rush. When disabled, the glow will stay at full brightness. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushSummaryStartCost: A hemogen rush costs {5} hemogen to start, then spends {0} hemogen per second and stops at {1}, so a rush started at 100 hemogen lasts {2}. The pilot moves at {3} speed and does {4} melee damage.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushSummary: A hemogen rush spends {0} hemogen per second and stops at {1}, so a rush started at 100 hemogen lasts {2}. The pilot moves at {3} speed and does {4} melee damage.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushSummaryStartCostNoDrain: A hemogen rush costs {2} hemogen to start and spends none after that, so it runs until the pilot stops it. The pilot moves at {0} speed and does {1} melee damage.
LanguageData.HPWC_RushSummaryFree: A hemogen rush spends no hemogen, so it runs until the pilot stops it. The pilot moves at {0} speed and does {1} melee damage.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberStrikesDesc: The number of strikes the shoulders hold when full. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberReloadCostDesc: The number of {1} it takes to reload one strike. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberWindupDesc: How long the pilot holds the target still before tearing off an arm or a leg. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberCooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait between strikes. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberDamageDesc: The damage a strike does to the limb it takes hold of, before the pilot's melee damage factor. A limb with more health than that will be wounded instead of torn off. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberDrainTimeDesc: How long a hemogenic pilot spends draining hemogen from a human target. The pilot will gain the same hemogen however long it takes, and less if the drain is cut short. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberGainDesc: The hemogen the pilot gains from a full drain, more from a larger target and less from a child. At zero, the pilot will not drain the target. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberBloodLossDesc: The blood loss a full drain causes in the target, on top of the bleeding from the lost limb. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberSpatterDesc: The number of blood spatters a strike will leave on the ground around the target. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberNonHostileDesc: When enabled, the pilot will be able to dismember targets that are not hostile, but this will anger their faction. When disabled, only hostile targets can be dismembered. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberBeheadDesc: When enabled, a large creature that never had arms or legs, such as a diabolus, will lose its head instead, which kills it. When disabled, such creatures cannot be targeted. A small one, such as a snake, will always lose its head. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberHemohunterDesc: When enabled, an aggressive pilot who becomes a hemohunter will dismember targets instead of biting them while the shoulders have strikes left. When disabled, the pilot will only bite. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberSummary: The shoulders hold {5}, and each one is reloaded with {6}. A strike takes {0} to cast, and a hemogenic pilot then drains a human target for {2}, which gives {3} hemogen and causes {4} blood loss. The cooldown after a strike is {1}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberSummaryNoCooldown: The shoulders hold {5}, and each one is reloaded with {6}. A strike takes {0} to cast, and a hemogenic pilot then drains a human target for {2}, which gives {3} hemogen and causes {4} blood loss. The next strike can follow at once.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberSummaryNoDrain: The shoulders hold {5}, and each one is reloaded with {6}. A strike takes {0} to cast, and the pilot does not drain the target. The cooldown after a strike is {1}.
LanguageData.HPWC_DismemberSummaryNoCooldownNoDrain: The shoulders hold {5}, and each one is reloaded with {6}. A strike takes {0} to cast, and the pilot does not drain the target. The next strike can follow at once.
LanguageData.HPWC_SectionHelmetDesc: The sealed visor of the hemophage warcasket helmet, which keeps sunlight off a pilot who is sensitive to it and steadies a pilot who is afraid of fire.
LanguageData.HPWC_HelmetSunlightDesc: When enabled, the helmet will protect a pilot with a UV sensitivity gene from the effects of sunlight. When disabled, sunlight will slow such a pilot and lower their mood as usual. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_HelmetPyrophobiaDesc: How often a pilot with the pyrophobia gene will flee in terror from a nearby fire, compared to the same pawn without the helmet. At 100%, the helmet will make no difference. At 0%, the pilot will never flee from fire. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_SectionWorkDesc: The work types a pilot of the hemophage warcasket can do, out of those that warcasket pilots normally cannot. Work that another mod opens for all warcasket pilots will stay open.
LanguageData.HPWC_WorkDesc: When enabled, pilots of the hemophage warcasket can do this work, though you will need to assign it in the work tab. When disabled, they cannot. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.HPWC_WorkSummary: The pilot can do {0} work, as well as the work that all warcasket pilots can do.
LanguageData.HPWC_WorkSummaryNone: The pilot can only do the work that all warcasket pilots can do.
LanguageData.HPWC_WorkSummaryNothingBlocked: No work is blocked for warcasket pilots, so there is nothing to enable here.
